Data:Nxc.n.revolution.surging.chaima.ass.label: Assist the Legion
Data:Nxc.n.revolution.surging.chaima.ass.preface: 'I've promised my services to the Legion one more time. And I don't know the Bounds-routes near Meshad. The Company of the Wolf-in-Gold fought there long ago, and Harries wrote of it. Do you have the book? Or something else I could use? [Sharps 10+]'
Data:Nxc.n.revolution.surging.chaima.ass.desc: 'That's of no use to me. Do you have something more?'

Data:Nxc.n.revolution.surging.hokobald.a.label: Another Way
Data:Nxc.n.revolution.surging.hokobald.a.preface: 'I have been offered - let us call it a commission - if I sway these rebels to the Hour-to-Come, the Chandler. But they are aggravatingly close to victory - and their loyalty to the Fourfold is renewed. I'll need powerful materials [Great Signs and the Great Scars 14+] to sway them. Or there may be a strong argument that the Chandler is the oldest Hour - if you know the work that I mean. The Zurvanists respect the compulsions of fate and time...'

Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.aladim.assist.a.label: Assist al-Adim
Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.aladim.assist.a.preface:
Dappled roses are a weapon against Calyptra - a weapon made for the Vagabond and her allies among the Hours. Now the Vagabond is calling on old alliances to strengthen her hand. Where his patroness goes, al-Adim must follow.

''It worries me greatly, Librarian - dissent among the Hours - alliances with those who came before us... but she has been good to me, and I am loyal. I will help her recruit the Glaeterfleoge-kind to tend her gardens. Please: share with me whatever material you might have concerning Miah.'
Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.aladim.assist.a.desc: 'There's nothing of particular use here, I'm afraid. What else do you have?'

Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.arun.assist.aru.desc: 'No no no. Where, Librarian, is the yes yes yes?'

Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.dagmar.assist.d.label: Assist Dagmar
Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.dagmar.assist.d.preface: Dappled roses are a weapon against Calyptra - a weapon made for the Vagabond and her allies among the Hours. Now the Vagabond is calling on old alliances to strengthen her hand. Dagmar finds it all 'rather smashing.' 'Between you and me, Libsy, I've always admired the Vagabond. Doesn't take no for an answer, makes her own way wherever she wants to be. Well, the Carapace Cross out in the ruins in Miah aren't signed up to the Vagabond's plan just yet. I'm hoping I can nudge 'em. Just need to gen up a bit on Miah first. What d'you have?'
Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.dagmar.assist.d.desc: 'Come on, Libsy, I need more from you than that! Sorry. Bit excited. But you must have something better?'

Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.olympe.assist.o.label: Assist Olympe
Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.olympe.assist.o.preface:
Dappled roses are a weapon against Calyptra - a weapon made for the Vagabond and her allies among the Hours. Now the Vagabond is calling on old alliances to strengthen her hand. Olympe would happily see Calyptra weakened - but the alliance with the Carapace Cross has her worried.

''The Vagabond is one of the Hours friendliest to humankind. If she recruits the Cross to tend her weapons… if she has less use for us… I fear she might become less kindly inclined to us. I would like to discourage this alliance, Librarian. Please: give me anything you have on Miah.'
Data:Nxc.n.rose.revealed.olympe.assist.o.desc: 'I need more detail on Miah - if you have it?'

Data:Nxc.n.saint.buried.stanislav.help.s.label: Help Stanislav resolve the saint-dreams
Data:Nxc.n.saint.buried.stanislav.help.s.preface: 'If you have Xi on the traditions of the Cross - or anything from the Cucurbit days about arousing Cross-consciousness - I am considering sharing that with the Church. If not, well, it's probably safer to tame the dreams anyway - with Rites of the Roots [10], or Coseley's work on the Cross Within.'
Data:Nxc.n.saint.buried.stanislav.help.s.desc: 'Sorry, Librarian, I think I'll need something different…'

Data:Nxc.n.saint.burnt.aladim.help.al-ad.label: Help al-Adim resolve the matter of the Croix-de-Feu
Data:Nxc.n.saint.burnt.aladim.help.al-ad.preface: 'I said to you once that we are unlikely to be friends with those who came before. Now that we have burnt their memento, I suppose it is a fraction less likely. So we must put an end to these dreams. If you have anything on Quenching & Quelling [10], that would be perfect: we could end them for good. But I would settle for containing  them with treatments for the sleepers - if you have Orchids & Narcotics [10] or Herbs & Infusions [10].'
Data:Nxc.n.saint.burnt.aladim.help.al-ad.desc: 'Thank you, Librarian, but that wasn't what I needed.'

Data:Nxc.n.skin.free.refuse.zachary.and..desc: Did I need Zachary for my own purposes? Did I enoy his company? Or did I fear what he might become? No-one ever knows the heart of the Librarian of the House.

What is in me is a mask. Perhaps the face is brighter. I need to know more of Pentiments & Precursors [12]. Or there was a film I saw, years ago, about four-winged angels. Something about that film moves in my chest...'
Data:Nxc.n.skin.free.zachary.help.zachar.desc: 'I'm sorry. I could make nothing of this.'

Data:Nxc.n.tapestry.investigated.connie..preface: 'I'm thinking about resigning. There are always compromises, at this level, but this is a new kind of compromise... on the other hand, if I stay, I can make a difference, if I leave, I give up that power. Librarian, if you have something on the Bureau's history - achievements - triumphs - mistakes…' [Some books will convince Connie to stay; others will convince her to leave the Bureau and indeed the game.]
Data:Nxc.n.tapestry.investigated.connie..desc: 'Nothing that could help? Thank you for looking. Let me know if you do find anything.'

Data:Nxh.n.absent.aladim.acted.aladim.st.desc: 'Medusa will enter History; as, I hope, will the other powers of Stone.'
'There it is. Perhaps it's time for Medusa to rejoin the Seglaz-kind.'

Data:Nxh.n.absent.aladim.s.killasimi.jso.desc: 'Yes. I think she will find the end a mercy.'

Data:Nxh.n.absent.aladim.s.ramsund.json.desc: 'If Medusa abandons that part of her that was Stone - if she has already abandoned that part of her that was Carapace - would she become mortal? I think it unlikely. But there is a sort of precedent - and it would be fitting to learn that Medea was Medusa's precursor...'

Data:Nxh.n.absent.arthur.acted.arthur.st.desc: ''That which we do not see, but by which we are seen…' If I can understand Medusa - that will satisfy the Labyrinth.'

Data:Nxh.n.absent.arthur.s.killasimi.jso.desc: 'It comes to us all, doesn’t it, Librarian? Even Long. Even Ligeians. Even higher powers still…'

Data:Nxh.n.absent.arthur.s.ramsund.json.desc: 'Formally, I think, if she abandons stone, the Labyrinth would describe her as mortal… I don't buy it. But something will change; and my teachers will, I think, be pleased with me.'

Data:Nxh.n.apollo.agdistis.acted.agdisti.desc: 'Yes, I recall this one. There is a little note on the duendrazones - but I need more. I am sorry.'
'Elodie will rise to join the Thunderskin; she will work to preserve the skin of the world; or she will not. It's in her hands now. And her heart, her voice, her feet... Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.apollo.agdistis.r.tridesmahie.desc: 'Elodie will rise to join the Thunderskin; she will work to preserve the skin of the world; or she will not. It's in her hands now. And her heart, her voice, her feet... Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.apollo.corso.acted.corso.oper.desc: 'I think, Librarian, that's done it. Lady has wings in her wist, you might say. Quick learner. I can't help wondering if I've been taken advantage of… not your problem, though. Thanks, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.apollo.corso.r.resurgences.em.desc: 'I think, Librarian, that's done it. Lady has wings in her wist, you might say. Quick learner. I can't help wondering if I've been taken advantage of… not your problem, though. Thanks, Librarian.'

Data:Nxh.n.apollo.morgen.acted.morgen.op.desc: 'Not very much on duendrazones here, is there? I shall hope you have something better.'
'Perfect, Librarian, perfect. Now I will have, let us say, a friend in the orchestra.'
'Perfect, Librarian, perfect. Now I will have, shall we say, a friend in the right place, at the very best time.'
